Container.Name: open-archiver-aio
Container.Overview:
All-in-one Open Archiver for Unraid: the self-hosted email archive (PST, mbox, EML, IMAP, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365) with PostgreSQL 17, Valkey, Meilisearch and Apache Tika bundled in one container. Full-text search covers email bodies and attachments (PDF, Word, Excel and more). The image is rebuilt automatically when Open Archiver publishes a release.
Set APP_URL to the exact address you open in your browser before the first start.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-11-09 - Recovers from unclean shutdowns (stale PostgreSQL lock files). - Warns in the log when appdata or archive storage is nearly full. - Meilisearch snapshots are now off by default; the upgrade backup copy is skipped when it would not fit.
### 2026-11-07 - Initial release: Open Archiver (tracks upstream releases), PostgreSQL 17, Valkey, Meilisearch and Apache Tika under s6-overlay v3. - Secrets generated on first boot and persisted to /config/keys. - Automatic Meilisearch upgrade handling when a new image ships a newer search engine.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Open Archiver web interface. If you change the host port, change APP_URL to match.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, search index, queue and the generated keys (keys/). Keep it on the cache pool and include it in your backups.

Config.Name: Archive Storage
Config.Description: Where archived emails and attachments are stored. Expect roughly the size of your unique mail. A user share on the array is fine.

Config.Name: Import Folder (PST/mbox/EML)
Config.Description: Read-only folder with files to import. In Open Archiver choose PST Import > Local Path and enter /imports/yourfile.pst.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: The exact URL you use in the browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000 (or your reverse-proxy https address). Logins and uploads fail if this does not match.

Config.Name: Storage Encryption
Config.Description: Encrypt archived files at rest (AES-256). The key is created on first boot in /config/keys/storage-encryption.key: back it up, without it the archive cannot be read. Once a key exists it is always used.

Config.Name: Ingestion Workers
Config.Description: Mailbox jobs processed at once. Raise on servers with more RAM (max 32).

Config.Name: Indexing Worker Heap (MB)
Config.Description: Memory ceiling for the indexing worker.

Config.Name: Meilisearch Indexing Memory
Config.Description: Optional cap for Meilisearch while indexing, e.g. 2GiB. Blank = Meilisearch default (2/3 of RAM).

Config.Name: Meilisearch Snapshot Interval (s)
Config.Description: Blank = no snapshots (recommended: the index can be rebuilt from the archive). A number = seconds between snapshots in /config/meilisearch/snapshots; each one is a full copy of the index and needs that much free space.

Config.Name: Tika Enabled
Config.Description: Use the bundled Apache Tika for attachment text (PDF, Office, and more). false = built-in extractors only (PDF, DOCX, XLSX).

Config.Name: Upload Size Limit
Config.Description: Largest file accepted through browser upload. Large PSTs should use the Import Folder instead.

Config.Name: Allow Deletion
Config.Description: Allow deleting archived emails and ingestion sources.

Config.Name: Meilisearch Upgrade Mode
Config.Description: When a new image ships a newer Meilisearch: dumpless = migrate the index in place (after a backup copy); rebuild = start an empty index, then run Admin > Index > Full rebuild.

Config.Name: Meilisearch Upgrade Backup
Config.Description: Copy the index before a dumpless upgrade (needs free space equal to the index size).
